summary: Connects a TCP socket to the host named by the global string at 0x005E4EF8 (::name) on port 0x70E4 (28900). Builds an AF_INET sockaddr, using inet_addr on the hostname and falling back to gethostbyname when that returns -1, then creates a stream socket with socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP) storing the handle at this[34] (offset 0x88), and connects. Returns 0 on success, 1 if socket creation failed, 2 if hostname resolution failed, 3 if connect failed (closing the socket first). Called by DeviceInitializationWithStateSetup (0x00562C90).

operations.description: Build the AF_INET sockaddr: set sa_family to 2, store htons(0x70E4) as the port in network byte order, and place the result of inet_addr(::name) into the address field.
If inet_addr(::name) returned -1, fall back to resolving the host via gethostbyname(::name); if gethostbyname returns null, return error code 2 (resolution failure).
On successful gethostbyname, copy the first address from the resolved host's h_addr_list into the sockaddr address field.
Create a TCP stream socket with socket(2, 1, 6) and store the returned handle into this[34] (offset 0x88).
If socket() returned -1 (invalid socket), return error code 1 without attempting to connect.
Call connect on the socket handle with the 16-byte sockaddr; when it returns 0, return 0 as success.
On connect failure, close the socket via closesocket(this[34]) and return error code 3.
Return the status code: 0 success, 1 socket creation failure, 2 hostname resolution failure, 3 connect failure.
